caseName: Federal Power Commission v. Southern California Edison Co.
caseNameFull: Federal Power Commission v. Southern California Edison Co. and City of Colton v. Southern California Edison Co.
attorneys: Northcutt Ely and C. Emerson Duncan II on the motion. Harry W. Sturges, Jr. and Boris H. Lakusta for Southern California Edison Co., and /. Thomason Phelps for Public Utilities Commission of California, respondents, in opposition to the motion.

opinions.text: Certiorari, 372 U. S. 958, to the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit. The motion of American Public Power Assn, for leave to file a brief, as amicus curiae, is granted.
